facts.fact: The WHO and Ministry of Health maturity assessment states that DHIS 2 is implemented at national and sub-national/district levels, with integration of health programme data into it still in progress and routine report completeness at 62% (indicator data 57%); the brief is dated February 2025.

The WHO and Ministry of Health self-assessment scores strategic planning for the health information system at 13% and HIS financing at 7%, and lists an HIS policy, a strategic plan for HIS and financing for HIS among components still to be established; the brief is dated February 2025.

systems.tiers: national and sub-national/district levels; facility tiers not stated
